title: Fix CAD Mesh and Brep Edge Display
description: CAD meshes display shredded with holes because fixture wires are imported with wrong edge orientation (54/57 forest wires). Lines are unclean because B-rep edge samples are dropped and World3d falls back to EdgesGeometry on bad mesh. Fix wire_points chaining, carry edge_positions through mesh_data_from_mesh_transfer, prefer B-rep edges over EdgesGeometry in World3d.
summary: Fixed structure model definition line display. Structure curves (walls/columns) were swept into tube solids and outlined with tessellated mesh edges; now tessellate the wire handle directly for clean centerline edge_positions with no shaded tube mesh. Face/surface primitives now get boundary edge_positions from outer-wire sampling in BrepkitKernel. World3d renders edge-only meshes (curve centerlines) without requiring triangle indices and allows mesh picking on edge lines.
